ado.r1_t: Your relationship is still finding its way
ado.r1_d: This isn't a verdict. But your answers show something's off, maybe communication isn't clicking yet, different expectations, or a relationship that's just starting. Take time to really talk, without phones, without the group chat.
ado.r1_a: Try having a real conversation, {{name1}} and {{name2}}, without your phones, without pressure. Ask yourselves: what do you really expect from each other?
ado.r2_t: You have something, but it needs work
ado.r2_d: There's a real foundation between {{name1}} and {{name2}}. Strong moments, a connection that exists. But some areas are still fuzzy. What matters is whether you both want to go for it.
ado.r2_a: Take a moment to talk about what's working between you, and what could improve. The key is making these conversations regular.
ado.r3_d: {{name1}} and {{name2}}, you know each other, you trust each other, you see a future. It's not perfect (it never is) but it's solid.
ado.r3_a: Keep surprising each other and don't take anything for granted. Solid couples are those who keep nurturing their relationship.
ado.r4_t: Your relationship really has what it takes to last
ado.r4_d: {{name1}} and {{name2}}'s answers paint a picture of a couple that communicates, respects each other, plans ahead, and makes each other happy. That's rare, and it needs nurturing.
ado.r4_a: Enjoy every moment together. Relationships like yours don't happen by accident, they're built day after day.
